docs.summary: A runtime pose node. After [`Update`](#api~Prowl.Motion.PoseNodeInstance~Update), [`Pose`](#api~Prowl.Motion.Pose) holds the produced pose, [`RootMotionDelta`](#api~Prowl.Motion.PoseNodeInstance~RootMotionDelta) the root motion for the step and [`SampledEventRange`](#api~Prowl.Motion.SampledEventRange) the events its subtree sampled. Each instance owns its pose buffer (direct evaluation, no task system).

docs.summary: Initializes the node to start playing at `initialTime` on its sync track, or at the very start when null.
Produces this update's pose, root motion and events. A node not yet initialized is initialized first. A second update in the same frame is ignored and keeps the first result.
